section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1973
title: 20 ## VOLUME OF SUICIDES, DISTRIBUTION OF SUICIDES IN STATES, UNION TERRITORIES AND METROPOLITAN CITIES The volume of crime per one lakh of population is on the decline for the past three years although the decline is quite marginal. The volume of suicides was 7·94 in 1971, in 1972 it came down to 7·76 and in 1973 to 7·11. The maximum volume of suicides per one lakh of population was reported from the state of Tripura (21.77). Among Union territories, the maximum volume was reported from Pondicherry (63·36) followed by A&N. Islands (55·00). The city of Bangalore topped the list among metropolitan cities with 26·47 suicides per one lakh of population.
